decision.adopt: Retain dominance as the current mechanical reopening rule for this explicitly projected disjunctive-support semantics.
decision.reject: Do not describe either snapshot as independent real-world semantic validation, graph-access efficiency, multi-hop repair, handoff success, or decision efficacy.
decision.reason: The expanded same-project snapshot reproduced exact mechanical targeting, but every one of 50 affected node-opportunities was an immediate changed-edge head; there were zero multi-hop effects, actions, or results in the affected set.

scope_corrections: The graph topology is real project state, but withdrawal events and disjunctive-support semantics are author-constructed.
Multiple incoming edges do not independently establish semantic substitutability.
20,193 is 127 result-kind nodes multiplied by 159 event opportunities, not 20,193 distinct scientific results.
The reported inspection fraction counts a logical neighborhood; the implementation still parses and indexes the whole graph for each run.

exact_next_blocker: A frozen independently gold-labelled replay must contain at least one source → intermediate claim → non-leaf decision → action/result path with competing support, and a fresh-context decider must revise the affected decision while preserving an unaffected one.
